name: minifig
notes: Toy-brick minifigure assembled from real part geometry in ldraw/ (LDraw open parts library, CC BY 4.0). Numbers are in LDraw units (20 per brick stud), y up, front +z; the builder scales them by 0.0582 so the body is 5.35 studs tall. Arm and hand placement follows the library's own torso-with-arms-and-hands assembly (arms splayed 10 degrees, hands turned 45 degrees).
